content.short: XGang Zombie Hunter is an fps survival /adventure game build with Unity tools.
content.description:
XGang Zombie Hunters is a first-person survival and adventure game, offering both single and multiplayer modes with intense battles against zombie enemies. It sets itself apart by being one of the first P2P/P2E (pay-to-play-to-earn) passive income generator in the gaming industry. In this game, players must clear levels of zombies, search for items, and complete missions to progress.

They can collect, buy, trade, upgrade weapons and characters to enhance their gameplay experience.

Developed using Unity tools, XGang Zombie Hunters promises an adrenaline-fueled and immersive gaming experience. In a world overrun by the undead, a group of survivors banded together to form XGang Zombie Hunters. Led by the skilled trackers and strategists, they roamed the wasteland in search of safety and resources.

Their mission was simple: to find and destroy as many of the undead as possible in order to protect the remaining human population. Armed with a variety of weapons, they became expert zombie killers, using their skills and knowledge of the undead to outmanoeuvre their enemies.
